newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5-THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 14.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY FOR TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5-THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 14.

text.p: (All venues Luxembourg, Plateau de Kirchberg)
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-250 Futura Participation: free movement of persons. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty, article 52. National legislation on income tax subjecting the application of provisions relating to the losses of non resident taxable individuals firmly established in the member state concerned on the condition that the losses be in relation te indigenous income and that accounts be maintained and held inside the country. - Oral procedure C-233 Germany v/ Parliament and Council: free movement of persons. Annulment of Council directive 94/91/EEC of the European Parliament and Council of May 30, 1994, on guarantees on deposits. - (1015/0915 GMT) Oral procedure joined cases C-37/96, C-38/96 Sodiprem: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 95. New arrangements on dock dues in French overseas departments. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-57/95 France v/ Commission: institutional law. Annulment of Commission communication 94/C 360/08 on an internal market for pension funds. Freedom to manage and place funds by pension bodies.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-302/95 Commission v/ Italy: environment and consumers. Non respect. Failure to have adopted or communicated implementation provisions of Council directive 91/271/EEC of May 21, 1991, on treatment of urban sewage.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-285/94 Italy v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of regulation 1840/94 of July 27, 1994, laying down olive and oil output for the 1993-1994 campaign. Adjustments in relation to data furnished by Italy.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-117/95 Corman v/ Commission: agriculture. Annulment of article 1, point 4 of regulation 455/95 of February 28, 1995, amending regulation 570/88 on the discounted sale of butter and the grant of an aid for butter and concentrated butter intended for the production of pastry, ice creams and other food products as it relates to the definition of butter eligible for Community aid.
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 7

COURT OF JUSTICE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-10/96 Aves: environment and consumers. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 5, 9 and 18 of Council directive 79/409/EEC of April 2, 1979, on the preservation of wild birds. National law allowing the continued capture of wild birds for recreational purposes so that devotees not be obliged to change their facilities or customs. National legislation allowing the authorisation of the capture of wild birds in order to avoid the negative effects of inbreeding among birds farmed for recreational purposes.

FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure C-164/95 Fabrica de Queijo Eru Portuguesa: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Commission regulation 316/91 of February 7, 1991, on the classification of certain goods in the Combined Nomenclature. Positions NC 0406 2090 (grated and powdered cheeses, all types) and NC 0406 9011 (cheeses other than fresh, grated or powdered, melted or in parsleyed pastes, intended for processing). Grated, compressed and packaged cheese with oxygen substitution by nitrogen injection, compact and pasty in appearance, but separating into irregular granules after unwrapping and exposure to surrounding conditions. - Oral procedure C-278/95-P Siemens v/ Commission: state aid. Provision against Court judgment rendered June 8, 1995, in case T-459/93, Siemens v/ Commission. Appeal for annulment of Commission decision 92/483 of June 24, 1992, on aids to the Brussels-Capital region (Belgium) in favour of the data processing and telecommunications activities of Siemens SA. Error in law.

FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-126/94 Cadi Surgeles: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council decision 89/688 of December 22, 1989, on dock dues in French overseas departments. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9, 12 and 227. - Judgment C-77/95 Zuechner: social policy. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of Council directive 79/7/EEC of December 19, 1978, on the progressive implementation of the principle of equal treatment for men and women in social security matters. Scope of application. Active population. Married woman caring for a sick husband. Indirect discrimination. Obligation to compensate individuals for the non transposition of a directive. Responsible body. - Opinion C-297/95 Commission v/ Germany: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed Council directive 91/271/EEC of May 21, 1991, on the treatment of urban sewage. - Oral procedure C-260/95 DFDS: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 26, of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Special arrangements for travel agencies. Agency having its operating base in member state A, supplying package tours to travellers through the agency of a company established in member state B. Notion of "member state in which a travel agent has established the operating base of its economic activity" and of a "stable establishment" from which services are provided. - (1030/0930 GMT) Oral procedure C-300/95 Commission v/ United Kingdom: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Incomplete transposition of Council directive 85/374/EEC of July 25, 1985, on the coordination of laws, regulations and administrative provisions of member states on responsibility for defective products and in particular of article 7(e) of said directive. Internal law providing less strict responsibility provisions than the directive. - (1530/1430 GMT) Oral procedure C-103/96 Eridania Beghin-Say: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of article 9 of Council regulation 3677/86 of November 24, 1986, laying down provisions for the implementation of regulation 1999/85 on inward processing relief arrangements. Equivalent compensation mechanisms. Cane and beet sugars.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-221/94 Commission v/ Luxembourg: approximation of legislation. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directive 91/263/EEC of April 29, 1991, on the approximation of member states' legislation on telecommunications terminal equipment, including the mutual recognition of their conformity. - Judgment C-262/95 Commission v/ Germany: environment and consumers. Non-respect. Failure te have transposed Council directives 82/176/EEC of March 22, 1982, on limit values and quality objectives for mercury discharges by the chlor-alkali electrolysis industry, 83/513/EEC of September 26, 1983, on limit values and quality objectives for cadmium discharges, 84/156/EEC of March 8, 1984, on limit values and quality objectives for mercury discharges by sectors other than the chlor-alkali electrolysis industry, 84/491/EEC of October 9, 1984, on limit values and quality objectives for discharges of hexachlorocyclohexane, 86/280/EEC of June 12, 1986, on limit values and quality objectives for discharges of certain dangerous substances included in List I of the Annex to Directive 76/464/EEC. Fixing of limit values by means of administrative provisions without constraints on private persons. - Judgment C-315/95 Commission v/ Italy: agriculture. Non-respect. Failure to have transposed within the prescribed period Council directives 93/85/EEC of October 4, 1993, on the control of potato ring rot, 93/61/EEC of July 2, 1993, setting out the schedules indicating the conditions to be met by vegetable propagating and planting material, other than seed, pursuant to Council Directive 92/33/EEC, 93/49/EEC of June 23, 1993, setting out the schedule indicating the conditions to be met by ornemental plant propagating material and ornemental plants pursuant to Council directive 91/682/EEC, 93/48/EEC of June 23, 1993, setting out the schedule indicating the conditions to be met by fruit plant propagating material and fruit plants intended for fruit production, pursuant to Council directive 92/34/EEC, 93/52/EEC of June 24, 1993, amending directive 89/556/EEC on animal health conditions governing intra-Community trade in and imports from third countries of embryos of domestic animals of the bovine species. - Opinion C-80/95 Harnas and Helm: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 4, paragraph 2, 13b(d), points 1 and 5, and 17, paragraph 3(c) of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Acquisition and detention of securities not in relation to the activity of a company. Exemption of the said activity in so far as it concerns securities issued by a person residing outside the Community.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-298/94 Roquette Freres v/ Council: agriculture. Annulment of Council regulation 1868/94, of July 27, 1994, laying down a quota policy on the production of potato flour. Special calculation system for Germany. Principle of non discrimination.
PROVISIONAL AGENDA FOR TUESDAY-THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 12-14
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 12

COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-84/94 United Kingdom v/ Council: social policy. - Judgment C-201/94 Smith and Nephew Pharmaceuticals: free movement of goods. Opinion C-24/95 Alcan Deutschland: state aid. - Oral procedure C-70/95 Sodemare: free movement of persons. - (1100/1000 GMT) Oral procedure C-368/95 Familapress Zeitungsverlag: free movement of goods.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-390/94 Schroeder v/ Commission: agriculture.
WEDNESDAY, NOVEMBER 13
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, SECOND CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-260/94 Air Inter v/ Commission: transport.
THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 14

COURT OF JUSTICE, SECOND CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-305/94 Rotsart de Hertaing: social policy. - Oral procedure C-67/95 Rank Xerox Manufacturing: free movement of goods. - Oral procedure joined cases C-225/95, C-226/95, C-227/95 Kapasakalis: free movement of persons.
THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-273/95 Buratti: agriculture.
FOURTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure joined cases C-274/95, C-275/95, C-276/95 Ludwig Wuensche: free movement of goods.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-333/94-P Tetra Pak International v/ Commission: competition. - Opinion C-97/95 Pascal and Filhos: external relations.

SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-171/95 Tetik: external relations. - Opinion C-344/95 Commission v/ Belgium: free movement of persons. - (1000/0900 GMT) Oral procedure C-351/95 Kadiman: external relations. - (1045/0945 GMT) Oral procedure C-45/95 Commission v/ Italy: taxation.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Oral procedure T-77/95 SFEI v/ Commission: competition.
